title: Pooled Outbound Transfer and Overage Billing, VPS and Dedicated Servers
content:
## The rule

Outbound transfer allowances of all of a customer's VPS servers in the VPS and Dedicated Servers range are pooled for each calendar month, and overage is billed only on the pooled usage above the pooled allowance. Pooled overage is billed per started TB at the tier's price per started TB of outbound transfer above the included amount, on the server with the highest usage that month, while dedicated servers are never pooled and are billed on their own usage. An overage line is billed once per server per month, after the month ends.

## The pooled quantities for one calendar month

- **Pooled usage** is the total outbound transfer, in TB, shown on that month's usage reports of all of the customer's Harborline VPS servers that were active at any time in the month.
- **Pooled allowance** is the total of the included monthly outbound transfer of those same servers.
- **Pooled overage** is the pooled usage above the pooled allowance, counted in started TB: any part of a TB counts as a whole TB.

A VPS that was active on any day of the month belongs to that month's pool, including a server that was cancelled or suspended later in the same month. A Harborline Dedicated Standard or Harborline Dedicated Enterprise machine never enters the pool; its own usage that month is measured against its own allowance.

## Billing

- The overage line is billed after the month ends, from the month's usage reports.
- Pooled overage appears as one bandwidth overage line on the VPS with the highest outbound transfer that month.
- A server already carrying a bandwidth overage line for a calendar month is not billed a second one for that month; the evidence is the server's own billing lines for that month.

## Hypothetical illustration

The allowances, usages and price below are invented inputs, not Harborline figures.

A customer holds three VPS servers, all active during March, with hypothetical allowances of 3, 6 and 9 TB, so the pooled allowance is 18 TB.

| Case | Usage on the three servers (TB) | Pooled usage (TB) | Above the pooled allowance | Started TB billed | Line, at a hypothetical 7.00 per started TB |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 4.2, 7.1 and 8.0 | 19.3 | 1.3 TB | 2 | 14.00, on the server that used 8.0 TB |
| B | 4.2, 5.4 and 8.0 | 17.6 | none | 0 | no overage line |

In case B the first server used more than its own 3 TB, yet nothing is billed, because only the pooled usage above the pooled allowance is billed.

## Points of judgement

- **A dedicated machine and a VPS on the same account in the same month:** the VPS takes part in the pool; the dedicated machine is billed only on its own usage above its own allowance.
- **When is the month's overage billed?** After the calendar month ends, once per server for that month.
